input.title: Men's Christmas – It Looked Smaller at the Farm Embroidered Zip Hoodie
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

This christmas tree zip up hoodie is for the dad who picked the biggest tree on the lot and now has to get it through the door, zipped on for the tree farm and the long drive home with the trunk tied down.

A weary man in a knit beanie and a red plaid jacket holds a measuring tape beside a huge fir tree that towers over him, with a gold star and ornaments at its base, in sage, red, cream and gold with a worn print texture. IT LOOKED SMALLER runs above it in two lines and AT THE FARM below in tall condensed capitals, the last line wider than the first: coral and cream on Black and Navy, brick red and navy on Ash. The full print is on the back. On the front, a small Christmas tree with a star on top is embroidered on the left chest, and the word OOPS is stitched on the left cuff, in white thread on Black and Navy and navy thread on Ash. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed and stitched the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Regular fit zip-up hoodie with a metal zipper
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece, soft inside and outside
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Embroidered left-chest Christmas tree and left-cuff OOPS, printed back
  • Front pouch pockets and an unlined hood with color-matched drawcord
  • Double-needle stitching at shoulders, armholes, neck, waistband and cuffs
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 3 colors: Black, Navy and Ash
  • Blank product sourced from Honduras and El Salvador

Questions

How does the It Looked Smaller at the Farm zip hoodie fit?
The It Looked Smaller at the Farm christmas tree zip up hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a regular unisex fit in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for an easy layer over a tee, or go up one for a roomier fit. The first size exchange within 30 days is free.

Is this christmas tree hoodie warm enough for cold tree lots?
It is a mid-weight layer. The Graphic Tees Co. zip hoodie is a Gildan 18600 in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, soft inside and outside, with a metal zipper, front pouch pockets and an unlined hood. It handles cold tree lots, snowy driveways and the drive home with a tree on the roof well.

Where are the print and the embroidery on this zip hoodie?
The full design, IT LOOKED SMALLER above the tree and AT THE FARM below, is printed across the back so the zipper never splits it. On the front, a small Christmas tree with a star on top sits on the left chest with no words, and OOPS is stitched on the left cuff.

How do I care for the embroidery on this hoodie?
Zip the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie, turn it inside out and wash cold with similar colors, then tumble dry on low or hang dry. Skip bleach and do not iron over the stitching. The Christmas tree on the chest and the OOPS cuff are stitched thread, which keeps its shape wash after wash with gentle care.

Is it a good gift for a dad, and when should I order for Christmas?
Yes, for the dad who always picks the biggest tree and swears it looked smaller at the farm. Graphic Tees Co. makes each embroidered hoodie to order, so for Christmas order by about December 8. Orders over $45 ship free in the US, and one free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess on size.
